ask.placeholder: e.g. Which AI initiatives should we kill, and why?
ask.contract: Every answer is read from the loaded enterprise context and cited to its source — and says so honestly when the evidence isn't there.

suggestedQuestions: Tell me about our current banking technology, data, and AI-readiness landscape.
Summarize the business and technology landscape with volumetrics.
What is blocking value, AI scale, or modernization?
How do we compare to peers and what moves should follow?

signals.headline: Core and payments modernization decide whether digital value shows up.
signals.body: FedNow/RTP, ACH, wire, sanctions, fraud, and API gateway dependencies mean payments value should be sequenced as a cross-domain modernization path, not a channel feature.

move.title: Sunset Real-time scam & APP fraud detection and reallocate budget

signals.headline: AI scale is blocked by model-risk evidence, not by lack of use cases.
signals.body: Fraud, AML, lending, HR, servicing, and wealth AI need validation, restricted-data attestations, explainability, and monitoring before production scale.

move.title: Approve monitored scale of SAR narrative drafting copilot

signals.headline: Customer and transaction data products are the CDAO control point.
signals.body: Customer 360, fraud feature stores, transaction monitoring, and credit data products need certified semantics and lineage before the CIO can defend AI value claims.

move.title: Re-baseline Contact center next-best-action assist to a single high-value workflow

signals.headline: Usage-only AI reporting is not enough for the CFO.
signals.body: Tower spend and usage have to connect to realized value, control readiness, and risk status before expansion or renewal decisions.

move.title: Sunset Real-time scam & APP fraud detection and reallocate budget

signals.headline: Real-time scam & APP fraud detection has $47M committed and $0.0M realized.
signals.body: Owned by Chief Risk Officer at stage 'ideate' (confidence low); blocker: No measurable value after pilot; sunset and reallocate budget.

move.title: Gate scale of Real-time scam & APP fraud detection on measured value

signals.headline: On its core modernization metrics the enterprise sits in the third quartile — a 29-point gap to top quartile.
signals.body: Your value 56.0 vs industry median 60 and top quartile 74 (large enterprise peer group).

corpus.patternName: Model-risk gate before bank AI scale
corpus.whenToApply: Use when AI touches AML, fraud, lending, HR, wealth, or customer treatment.

corpus.patternName: Payments value gated by core and sanctions dependencies
corpus.whenToApply: Use when real-time payments value is claimed without core/sanctions evidence.

corpus.whenToApply: Use when AI triage is proposed for alert/case workload.
